institution: ICFO ? The Institute of Photonic Sciences

app_fee.value: No application fee is mentioned on ICFO's PhD program, fellowship, or ICFOjobs pages; applications are submitted online through ICFOjobs.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee or fee waiver is stated on ICFO's PhD pages.

gre_general.value: Submitting standardized test results (GRE, TOEFL, etc.) is optional across ICFO PhD fellowship calls and group openings, though helpful for evaluating degrees obtained outside the European Higher Education Area.
gre_general.quote: If available, scanned copy of standardized test results (GRE, TOEFL, etc.). Note that submission of test results is optional, but they can be particularly helpful for evaluating candidates with degrees obtained outside the European Higher Education Area.

toefl_min.value: No TOEFL certificate is required; ICFO requires a high working knowledge of English, and submitting standardized test results (TOEFL, etc.) is optional (though helpful for degrees from outside the EHEA).
